import_contract.occupancy: 0..1 numeric fractions or explicit percent strings, normalized once
import_contract.ambiguous: Bare values above 1 and explicit percentages above 100%, invalid formulas/dates/vendors, and duplicate departure identities quarantine the entire workbook before run writes or missing flags
import_contract.blanks: Null remains no-run; zero remains an observed empty load; workbook export preserves null
import_contract.identity: Explicit run labels reserved before unlabeled sheet-order sequences. Identical workbook reimports are stable; reordering unlabeled same-date rows cannot prove a persistent departure identity and should use explicit labels.
import_contract.provenance: Original cells/formulas, number formats, raw date, workbook epoch, sheet/row and SHA-256 retained in prior_values for accepted rows; quarantine report retains rejected evidence
import_contract.history: No deletions; full prior actual history retained without the former 25-entry truncation; conflicting source-owned history blocks writes; no auto-retraining on manual import

scoring.legacy: Existing mean departure occupancy per route-day retained for comparable finite records
scoring.strict: Single departure with occupancy 0..1, present in sheet, known current cutoff, finite served occupancy 0..1 from a date strictly before cutoff date
scoring.denominator: All in-scope route-days with non-null finite actuals; exclusions include no forecast; metrics denominator is eligible route-days and coverage separately discloses all actual route-days
scoring.timing: Date-only logs cannot establish cutoff-day intraday timing. Historical cutoff changes are unverified. A prior-day forecast can be selected even when a later cutoff-day estimate exists.
scoring.units: Mean occupancy and summed truck equivalents displayed separately. Ambiguous historical actuals have no fabricated total truck equivalents.

full_build.reason: Lovable MCP Vite plugin rejects Windows backslash routesDir against forward-slash root; identical on untouched source

npm_ci.reason: Tracked package-lock.json does not match package.json

checks.dependency_setup: npm install --package-lock=false --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; tracked dependency files unchanged; Node 22.18.0, npm 11.12.1, Vitest 4.1.11

source_p21_findings: Default orders SQL uses required_date/open remaining demand and item-master cube/weight, with no UOM/carton conversion in that query; it is not the agreed pick-ticket dispatch date rule. No default dispatch rule was changed.

Capacity ratio uses available pallet/cube/weight full-truck targets and max ratio, capped at 1.5. Live configured SQL, targets, equipment and dimension coverage were not inspected. No model tuning was performed.
remaining_evidence: October 12 workbook and actual import path
Production stored rows including missing flags and historical forecast coverage
Configured targets, equipment assumptions, P21 cube/UOM/carton coverage
Historical intraday forecast/cutoff timing cannot be reconstructed from date-only history
release_decisions: Review draft PR and exact revision before merge or production deployment
Validate build/type/lint in the supported deployment environment and resolve or explicitly accept baseline blockers
Establish units and source identity before allowing quarantined imports; any historical data repair requires separate approval
boundaries: No protected telemetry retries or alternate data routes, database repairs, snapshots, bridge jobs, retraining, production mutations, authentication/security changes, emails, merge or deployment. No guaranteed 80% result claimed.
